title: POV: it's 3pm, your 3pm isn't here, and isn't answering
description:
you held the slot. you turned someone away for it. now the chair's just sitting there.

chasing every client with a reminder text at night isn't a system, it's a second job.

with MyHour you get your own booking page for your bio. clients pick a free time themselves, get a confirmation email, and get one reminder email before the appointment, at a time you choose. if someone keeps not showing up, you can block them from booking online.

€9/month after a 14-day free trial, no card needed to start.
